name: Steamworks
description: Steam publisher API for listing owned games, build history, beta branches and depot versions, and requesting build promotion. Requires a Steamworks publisher Web API key. Game file uploads use SteamPipe/SteamCMD separately; store setup, Valve review and first release use the Steamworks dashboard. HTTP 201 from build promotion means Steam Mobile confirmation is pending, not that the build is live.

credential_fields.name: api_key
credential_fields.label: Publisher Web API Key
credential_fields.description: Steamworks publisher Web API key with access to the target apps. Use a publisher key, not a personal Steam community API key. Requests must run on a trusted server.

tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: List app IDs, names and types associated with this publisher key. Optionally filter by comma-separated types: game, application, tool, demo, dlc, music.

type_filter.description: Optional comma-separated app types, for example game,demo.

tools.name: list_builds
tools.description: Get build history for an app owned by the publisher key. Use the returned BuildID when requesting a build promotion after uploading through SteamPipe.

count.description: Number of builds to retrieve. Steam defaults to 10 when omitted.

tools.name: list_branches
tools.description: Get all beta branches for an app owned by the publisher key. Re-read branches after build promotion or mobile confirmation to verify the active build.

tools.name: get_depot_versions
tools.description: Get all versions of all content depots for an app owned by the publisher key. Useful for inspecting uploaded game content and deployment state.

tools.name: set_build_live
tools.description: Request promotion of an existing uploaded build to an explicitly selected branch. Use betakey=public for the default branch. For a released app's public branch, steamid is required and that account must confirm in Steam Mobile with Edit App and Publish permissions. HTTP 201 means confirmation is pending: success of the HTTP request does not mean the build is live. Preserve and inspect the response status/body, then verify with list_branches. This does not perform a game's first store release.

betakey.description: Explicit target branch name. Use public for the default branch; no default is selected automatically.

steamid.description: SteamID64 of the account confirming the change. Required for a released app's public branch. Pass as a decimal string to preserve 64-bit precision.
